subject: Console: route-slice inspector access & lightweight forensic widget request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.example.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Console: route-slice inspector access & lightweight forensic widget request

Hi team,

We had a hit overnight from Acme (Emma Torres copied on the support ticket) where a single route slice produced a 3x token spend bump and a correlated tail-latency spike. Emma's team can't drill into the payloads or sampling traces from their tenant view — they see only aggregate percentiles.

Can Product and Observability partner to add a lightweight "route-slice inspector" tile in the tenant console? Minimum capabilities I'm asking for:
- quick view of request distribution (p50/p95/p99) by route + slice
- ability to toggle sample rate for the last 1h/6h/24h windows
- one-click export of the last N request traces (redacts PII by default)
- surface the top 5 prompts by token cost for the slice

Operational constraints: must be read-only for customers; Product needs a toggle to grant broader internal drill perms (SRE/Support) for triage.

Emma pasted a screenshot and the initial HubSpot ticket; attaching a screenshot and a draft SQL I used to reproduce the counts.

Can we scope an MVP that is shippable within 3 sprints? If not, what is the minimal cut that buys us fast triage for customer escalations? Proposed owners: Marissa (UX/console), Dylan (telemetry infra), Lauren (policy/permissions).

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: screenshot-route-spike.png (image/png), slice_inspector_query.sql (text/sql)

--
Soojin Lee
Director, Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Console: route-slice inspector access & lightweight forensic widget request

Thanks for the heads up, Soojin — this looks actionable.

Quick clarifying questions before we scope:
- For the "top 5 prompts by token cost" — do we need full prompt text, or a hashed/partial preview is sufficient for privacy?
- Is the sampling toggle a UI switch that changes the backend sampling rate, or a query-time filter for the inspector view?

We should also decide whether this tile lives on the tenant home or under "Diagnostics". My preference is Diagnostics (keeps home uncluttered), but we can surface a summary as a home card. I added a short Notion note with mockups: https://notion.redwood.com/console/route-slice-inspector-proposal

If we aim for a 3-sprint timeline, I'd suggest an MVP that includes: percentile breakdowns + sample-rate filter + CSV export (no prompt text). Follow-on can add prompt previews and internal permission gating.

I'll carve out time this week to work the UX spec and sprint story set. Dylan — can you confirm feasibility of on-demand export of N traces and how expensive that is for a high-volume tenant?

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Console: route-slice inspector access & lightweight forensic widget request

Short answer: feasible, but there are cost/tradeoffs.

Notes from infra perspective:
- On-demand export of N traces requires pulling from the KV cache + request logs. For high-volume slices this can be throttled behind a job queue. We can provide a 'sample N in last T' API that is compute-light if we only store pointers and a small summary blob.
- Getting top prompts by token cost: we can surface token_count + truncated prompt preview (first 256 chars) to keep to privacy budget. Full prompt text should be restricted to internal roles only.
- Sample-rate toggle: should be a query-time view (no live change to ingestion sampling). Changing server-side sampling for ingestion is a heavy lift and requires infra coordination.

I've attached a quick SQL I used for Acme to reproduce the counts and a short forensic-notes.txt with my initial triage. If we proceed with the MVP (percentiles + sample-rate view + CSV export of summaries), infra estimates 2 sprint work for the API + 1 sprint for safe export/quotas.

JIRA: OBS-1427 is created for the infra story — link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OBS-1427

— Dylan

Attachments: slice_inspector_query.sql (text/sql), forensic-notes.txt (text/plain)

Subject: Re: Console: route-slice inspector access & lightweight forensic widget request

All — thanks for the triage and the realistic options.

I approve the proposed MVP scope (percentiles + sample-rate view + CSV export of summaries). A couple of policy notes:
- Customer-facing prompt previews must be truncated and redacted. Internal roles (SRE/Support/Legal) can request expanded views via an audited access flow.
- Add quota limits for export (max 10k traces per day per tenant) and a job-queue that respects nightly maintenance windows.

I'll route this into the Q2 roadmap board and tag it for a sprint kickoff right after the current release freeze. Marissa — please add the UX spec and acceptance criteria to OBS-1427. Dylan — pair with infra to size the job-queue and export throttling.

I'll loop in Legal if we need formal wording for prompt previews.

Thanks — Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
